source: PHC Core Rules v1.0 + Narrator's World Bible + Class Roster Rev 2

tiers.success: one blessing from patron list x blessing_power

tiers.trigger: after a successful prayer, until your next turn

tiers.effect: blessing at triple power, or a story-sized intervention the narrator designs

notes: Blessing numbers are provisional examples (the spec defers them here). Patron mood TN defaults to 12.

items.name: Holy Father Nerukhan
items.costume: a stern holy father who speaks for the saints; 'Only the saints may judge'
accord_terms: Pacts first: answers only those sworn to the Lumeri faith
Keep the costume: never speaks as anything but the Holy Father
The Veil: miracles are always framed as the saints' judgement
rites: a confession spoken before each fight
tithe a share of loot to a Lumeri shrine each session
taboos: passing final judgement on a person yourself (executing the surrendered)

blessings.name: Saint's Shield
blessings.text: An ally in sight gains a shield of 40.

blessings.name: Judgement
blessings.text: One enemy in sight takes 40 Soul damage; double against an enemy that harmed a surrendered or helpless foe this scene.

effects.note: double if the target harmed the helpless this scene

blessings.name: Absolution
blessings.text: One ally is cleansed of every Heart and Brain condition and heals 30.

items.source_note: Named in the 2020 material; reading as a Celestial in a pact is from the World Bible. Tenets, rites and blessings are new.

items.name: The Quartermaster
items.costume: a gruff, bottomless logistics officer of a war that never ended; a Celestial who loves strategy games
accord_terms: Quotas: asks for bots in kind, so prefers prayers made after a hard fight
tenets: Leave no one on the field
rites: log every round spent and every comrade lost, read aloud after the fight
taboos: hoarding supplies from your own squad

blessings.name: Resupply
blessings.text: Every ally in sight refills one magazine, or regains 1 Supplies, or loads a fresh small core.

blessings.name: Dig In
blessings.text: You and allies within 2 tiles count as in half cover until your next turn.

blessings.name: Covering Fire
blessings.text: An enemy in sight is Pinned (no save).

items.source_note: Invented to give Body characters a patron.

items.name: The Laughing Mask
items.costume: a grinning masked trickster who demands a show; a Celestial who joined the Accords to troll properly
accord_terms: Keep the costume: never removes the mask
The Veil: every miracle must look like luck
tenets: A lie told well is a gift
rites: a joke, prank or performance for the Mask each session
taboos: breaking a promise you made in jest
refusing a dare from an ally

blessings.name: Switcheroo
blessings.text: Swap places with any creature in sight.

effects.note: engine swaps positions; narrator rules on impossible tiles

blessings.name: Pratfall
blessings.text: One enemy in sight is Prone and Confused (Brain save for Confused only).

items.source_note: Invented; the World Bible says some Celestials troll for fun.
